new_C_specific_written_analysis.statement: Every literal THREE-WORD subcode {b,ba,v} with v one of the other14 Shor words has an explicit finite UD factor-complete extension by elementary suffix/prefix composition. Nevertheless those local completions cannot simply be unioned, and no code produced by the stated iterated prefix/suffix-composition class can contain ALL16 C words. This settles the scope of this source lead without pretending to have read its proof. It is a route analysis, not a new global Shor theorem or novelty claim.
new_C_specific_written_analysis.case_v_pure_start: If v=ba^j, j in{7,13,14}, the complete suffix code K_(j+1)={a^(j+1)} union {ba^t:0<=t<j+1} already contains b,ba,v.
new_C_specific_written_analysis.case_v_other_rows: For v=a^i b a^j with i in{3,8,11}, take K_i={P=a^i} union {B_t=ba^t:0<=t<i}. It is a complete suffix code, since its reversal is the complete prefix code {a^i} union {a^t b:0<=t<i}. Write j=d*i+r,0<=r<i. Then v is the ACTUAL K_i-product s=P B_r P^d, whose first abstract letter is P, different from b and ba.
new_C_specific_written_analysis.exact_finite_completion_formula: For any abstract word s=s1...sL over Sigma=K_i define N(s)={s1...s_q c:0<=q<L,c in Sigma,c!=s_(q+1)} union {s}. This is the full finite prefix tree with one continued spine. Its binary substitution M_v through K_i is a finite RAW set. Root off-spine letters include b and ba, and the spine leaf is the literal v.
new_C_specific_written_analysis.UD_and_completeness_proof: K_i is UD as a suffix code, so substitution is injective on ALL abstract strings. N(s) is prefix, hence its binary substituted code is UD by cancellation/unique abstract decoding. Let mu be binary mass on K_i; sum mu=1. The off-spine masses telescope: sum_q mu(s1...s_q)*(1-mu(s_(q+1)))+mu(s)=1. The finite raw M_v therefore has Kraft1 and is factor-complete by the named elementary UD/Kraft theorem. No parser or finite check was executed.
new_C_specific_written_analysis.actual_incompatibility_example: Take i3, P=aaa and Sigma={b,ba,baa,P}. The code M1={b,ba,baa,a^3b,a^3ba,a^3ba^2,a^6} is the spine completion for s=P b and contains v1=a^3b. The completion M2 from N(P b P P) contains v2=a^3ba^6 and also the off-spine leaf P P=a^6. Thus M1 union M2 contains the distinct factorizations (a^3b)(a^6)=(a^3ba^6). Both M1 and M2 separately complete the relevant literal Shor triple, but their union is not UD. This is not a proof that DIFFERENT local completions cannot coexist; it disproves the automatic union/amalgamation inference.
new_C_specific_written_analysis.uniform_composition_class_barrier: If a code S is wordwise Parikh-equivalent to a prefix code P, composing S with an abstract PREFIX code preserves that property by replacing each S letter with its corresponding P word. For an abstract SUFFIX code, first reverse the abstract word order: it becomes prefix and preserves each letter multiplicity, so the same conclusion holds. Induction from the binary alphabet proves that every finite iterated prefix/suffix-composed code is Parikh-equivalent to a prefix code.
new_C_specific_written_analysis.why_C_excludes_the_entire_class: C has16 distinct words with exactly ONE b and at most14 a's. In any prefix code with those Parikh data, at most one word can have each first-b delay i=0,...,14, since a^i b a^j words of the same i are prefix-comparable. At most15 are possible. Hence C is not Parikh-equivalent to a prefix code. If any code in the composition class contained C, restricting its equivalence to C would contradict this count. Therefore NO finite completion of C can lie in that particular construction class.
new_C_specific_written_analysis.critical_nonclaim: No claim is made that EVERY finite complete code is prefix/suffix-composed or Parikh-equivalent to a prefix code. The latter is the maximal-code conjecture already identified, not an available theorem. The unread2025 paper is NOT classified as prefix/suffix-composed: its methods might escape this class. Even a broader three-word completion result would still need a compatible all16-word realization/amalgamation proof.
